summary: A family of Israeli settlers was filmed taking boxes of grapes from a privately owned Palestinian vineyard; Israeli protective-presence activists and the Palestinian owners were then removed from the area by the IDF under a closed-military-zone order while the settlers initially remained.
discovery_sources: Times of Israel 2026-09-04; exact video filmed by Reservists Against Terror and embedded/reposted via Gilad Kariv
resolution_notes: The exact same-event footage and named-participant reporting make this a strong lead, but this pass found no independent or official event-level corroboration establishing the vineyard ownership/authorization facts, and the IDF had not commented. The activists later reported finding their vehicle tires punctured, but no perpetrator was identified, so that damage is not attributed to the settlers or merged as verified conduct. Preserve as Unresolved rather than lower corroboration standards.
